ledger.name: Teal Ledger
ledger.line: TDW teal, deepened, on warm stone greys. The closest to today, calmer.

slate.name: Slate and Teal
slate.line: Cool blue greys with a brighter teal. Reads most like a business tool.

indigo.name: Indigo and Marigold
indigo.line: Indigo for actions, marigold for the brand. No teal; the most formal.
